description: AI-optimized Iterable Handlebars reference structured for efficient lookups

file_guidance.start_here: index.json — find the category and helper name
file_guidance.helper_details: schema/helpers.json for established helpers; schema/helpers-2026.json for groupBy, sortBy, catalogCollection
file_guidance.patterns: schema/common-patterns.json for established patterns; schema/patterns-2026.json for groupBy/sortBy/catalog composition patterns
file_guidance.debugging: schema/troubleshooting.json for established issues; schema/troubleshooting-2026.json for groupBy/sortBy/catalog issues
file_guidance.skill_file: SKILL.md — Cursor skill for AI agent self-discovery and quick reference

HandlebarsArrayHelpers.behavior_when_off: Both helpers return empty string silently — no error, no output
HandlebarsArrayHelpers.how_to_enable: Must be enabled per-project by an Iterable admin in platform settings

common_tasks.logic_snippets: Use snippets with {{assign}} for drag-and-drop grids - extract data to numbered variables (product1Name, product2Name, etc.)
common_tasks.grid_layouts: Call logic snippet at top: {{{snippet "data-prep"}}}, then reference variables in static grid cells
common_tasks.group_items: Use {{#groupBy array field="fieldName" as |groups|}}...{{/groupBy}} — requires HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag
common_tasks.sort_items: Use {{#sortBy array field="fieldName" order="asc" as |sorted|}}...{{/sortBy}} — requires HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag
common_tasks.group_then_sort: Wrap groupBy with sortBy to pre-sort input, or use sortBy inside {{#each groups}} for inner-group sorting

syntax_rules.triple_braces: {{{field}}} - Renders HTML (use for trusted content only)
syntax_rules.data_feeds: [[field]] - Data feed syntax (or {{field}} with merged context)
syntax_rules.block_aliases: {{#each arr as |item idx|}} - Named block params for scoped @index access inside nested loops

catalog_field_access.rule: Catalog item fields are accessed directly at top level — dataFields wrapper is not present in Handlebars context

catalog_setup_order.rule: Set ALL field type mappings BEFORE loading catalog items
